request: Explain what getUserLabel does and why it can crash.

target.message:
`getUserLabel` looks up a user by id and returns their name in upper case.

It crashes when `database.find(userId)` returns `undefined`: the next line dereferences `user.name`, which throws a `TypeError`. The fix is to check for a missing user before reading its name.
